name: xml.c
documented_input_api: xml_parse_document(uint8_t *buffer, size_t length), then xml_document_root, xml_node_name, xml_node_content, xml_node_children / xml_node_child (README usage, src/xml.h)

popularity.metric: GitHub stars (secondary, repository interest, not downloads)

probe: Throwaway tree printer compiled with clang against the pinned src/xml.c in the pinned ubuntu image (linux/arm64, no network); it read each valid control and called xml_parse_document once. Not committed as a project.

controls/xml/catalog-ns.xml.result: rejected: xml_parse_document returned NULL ("xml_parse_node::tag missmatch" at 3:49)

controls/xml/order-default-ns.xml.result: rejected: xml_parse_document returned NULL ("xml_parse_node::tag missmatch" at 5:95)

cause: The README describes xml.c as a subset parser like GLib GMarkup. Its xml_parse_tag_open is documented as "Parses an opening XML tag without attributes": the tag name runs to ">", so <item id="a1"> never matches </item>. xml.c also states that CDATA is not supported and has no entity or character-reference decoding, XML declaration or comment handling.
decision: Fails both valid controls; the cell keeps its tenth slot open.
